text:
maria: quick spur-of-the-moment RFC follow-up idea: gateway emits a tiny opt-in "progress" signal plus a Priority-Hint so clients can degrade UX instead of hard timing out. wanted to throw tradeoffs + rollout notes here.
akshay: sounds useful. wire surface thoughts? header vs event-stream vs trailers?
maria: opt-in header + sparse progress events on streams. header examples: `Priority-Hint: low|normal|high` and `X-Redwood-Progress: enabled=true`. default: disabled unless client opts in.
dom: a few red flags: (1) cache-primed responses may look like progress and confuse UIs; (2) admission/backpressure must incorporate priority or we get starvation games.
olivia: observability side: add span tags `progress.stage` and `progress.attempt`; metric counters `progress.emitted` and `progress.missing`. keep cardinality low (coarse buckets for partial pct).
maria: proposed semantic stages (enum): queued, started, first_token, partial, final. progress_id to correlate attempts. sample text event (string): `progress_id=p-42-1; stage=partial; bucket=50; variant=small-fallback`. only emit variant on stage transitions to limit noise.
akshay: retries: increment attempt in progress_id (p-42-2). SDKs map Priority-Hint -> UI/backoff and may choose not to opt-in for privacy-sensitive routes.
dom: admission formula sketch: score = base_score - penalty(priority) - age_penalty. define soft-share reserve (eg 10-20%) qps for high priority to avoid evicting in-flight high calls. low-priority gets coarser progress cadence.
maria: security/privacy: progress leaks timing and model-variant info. keep opt-in and disable by default for enterprise/private installs unless explicitly enabled.
olivia: alerts: `p95 time_to_first_progress > 2s` for high-priority routes, and `progress_emitted_rate drop` on rollout. sample span tags: `progress.stage`, `progress.attempt`, `progress.variant` (optional).
akshay: rollout plan: feature-flag `progress-v1`; prototype on a single non-critical route (chat-beta); emit sparse events every ~2s or on stage-change; SDK README + opt-in; monitor noise for 1 week then expand.
maria: owners: @akshay prototype gateway headers+emitter, @olivia wire metrics+alerts, @dom draft eviction thresholds. i'll write the RFC follow-up with concrete enums and compat notes.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for feature/progress-v1 to staging at 1745560105 — CI green. :rocket:
akshay: will add a tiny SDK guide showing how to opt-in and interpret progress_id and attempt suffixes.
maria: thanks all. i'll post RFC follow-up with concrete examples and a short section on privacy controls. :thumbsup:
